title: Reference approach: Scientific Measurement Analyzer
approach: Validate external input shape, dtype, and fields before numerical work.
Use ndarray operations and choose explicit axes and tolerance rules.
Separate loading, transformation, analysis, and reporting into testable functions.
Use synthetic fixtures and test invalid/boundary cases.
Record assumptions, environment versions, and performance measurements.
acceptance_guidance: Read CSV or text data into arrays.
Detect NaN, infinity, invalid ranges, and missing readings.
Apply a documented filter/outlier rule without silently discarding data.
Write a cleaned numeric output and summary.
explanation: Load measurement data, validate it, clean it according to documented rules, and save the cleaned data. This is a reference approach, not a complete executable deliverable. Final reference code and tests require technical review before release.
